scope: Authored documentary evidence for classic GTIM input drivers. Reviewed each own-family CN manual, own SDK GTIM driver/header and selected SVD. A030 uses vendor common x030 manual. No vendor files redistributed; no hardware or firmware validation performed.
decision: All listed timer instances document capture, QEI, and ETR external counting. The viable initial common hardware subset is polling capture on a selected external channel, CH1/CH2 quadrature counting without CH3 index, and single-polarity ETR external counting with explicit external mux selection. Package pin availability still requires pin capability evidence.

capture.clear_basis: Every capture programming example reads CCR then explicitly writes zero to ICR.CCy; CCR registers are RW with no read-clear attribute, and SDK getters only read CCR. All SDK clear helpers separately assign ICR = ~mask. This is documentary evidence, not silicon measurement.
capture.overcapture_flag: Not documented in any reviewed GTIM ISR, ICR, or capture section. Do not promise detection of overwritten captures or event-loss-free polling.
capture.timestamp_width: 16-bit modulo ARR+1; set ARR=0xffff for modulo-65536 raw capture.

qei.index_options: CH3 ENCRESET bits18:17 and ENCRELOAD bits20:19 exist, but are outside simplest common subset.

prescaler_policy.qualification: Documented operating sequence plus explicit inference; no silicon validation.
prescaler_policy.documented: Every encoder section says counting is driven by each qualified CH1/CH2 transition. All own manual encoder programming sequences and own SDK GTIM_EncodeInit omit PRS/PSC writes. PSC reset is zero.
prescaler_policy.inference: QEI counting does not require programming the PCLK/TRS prescaler. Keeping reset PSC=0 / PRS=0 is consistent with the documented sequence; no programmable QEI prescaling should be exposed.
prescaler_policy.limits: No explicit statement that PSC is bypassed was found, so do not present bypass as a quoted hardware guarantee. The PSC=1 external TRS requirement belongs only to external-counter mode.
prescaler_policy.cmmr: Neither manual encoder sequences nor SDK encoder initialization require enabling CMMR capture mode.

external_counter.divider_warning: For separate PSC families PCLK uses divisor PSC+1, while external TRS uses divisor PSC with PSC>0. Use PSC=1 for one count per qualified ETR edge. For CR0.PRS families use PRS=0.

filters.channel: CR1: each channel nibble contains FLT bits[2:0] and POL bit3
filters.sampling_limit: Manual input-control sections caution that inputs above half the actual sampling frequency can be missed. No-filter does not establish an asynchronous unlimited-rate counter.

status_ack.ISR: Read-only state; OV0 TI1 UD2 CC1..4 bits3..6 DIRCHANGE9 DIR10
status_ack.ICR: R1W0 flags; selected bits written 0 clear, written 1 do nothing; DIR is not a clearable interrupt flag
status_ack.write_rule: Use one W0C write selecting only owned pending flags; do not read-modify-write a status register or assume CCR access acknowledges.

source_routing.capture: SYSCTRL_GTIMCAP / GTIMxCAP, CH1..4 fields at bits2:0,6:4,10:8,14:12; zero means GPIO AF source
source_routing.etr: SYSCTRL_GTIMETR, timer fields at 4*(instance-1), width3; zero means GPIO AF source
source_routing.external_route_requirement: Explicitly select external mux zero when acquiring an input; prior internal-source configuration can otherwise silently remain active.

family_differences: F002/F003 have one GTIM, F020/F030/A030/L083 four, L031/R031/W031 two, L052 three.
F002/F003/F020/F030/A030 use CR0.PRS bits10:7 (powers of two); L031/L052/L083/R031/W031 have a separate 16-bit PSC and reserved CR0 bits14:7.
L031/R031/W031 manuals use GTIM1 base 0x40000700 plus ARR offset0 while SDK/SVD use base0x40000400 plus offset0x300. These are equal absolute addresses, not a register-placement discrepancy.

L052 adds CR0.TI1XOR bit21 and IC1RST/IC2RST/IC3RST bits22..24; keep them zero for the initial independent-channel capture/QEI subset. Its selected SVD names CR0 bit4 POLARITY where other families name it POL.
F002/F003 internal capture/ETR codes3 and7 are not listed; other F-series and L031/R031/W031 code3 is UART3,4 VC1,5 VC2,6 LVD.
L052 capture source code4 is MCO; codes5/6/7 are VC1/VC2/LVD. UART3 code3 appears for CH1/2 but is omitted for CH3/4; ETR UART3 code3 appears for GTIM1/2 but is omitted for GTIM3.
L083 capture source codes3/4 are UART3/UART4 for CH1/2 and UART6/UART5 for CH3/4; codes5/6/7 are VC1/VC2/LVD. ETR routing uses first pair for GTIM1/2 and second pair for GTIM3/4.
All examined own manuals and selected vendor SVDs contain ENCMODE and the matching encoder status flags; no true QEI absence found.
